protocol.name: Table3A model cost and Table3B given-input25-frame efficiency v2
protocol.scene_selection: First manifest scene of each K, selected without timing results; equal scene weight
protocol.batch: One video; frame methods batch1, ATB retains its frozen two overlapping groups per internal call
protocol.core: Sum of explicitly named model/renderer regions, CUDA synchronize+wall clock. Outer decode/adapters, host/device transfers and final CPU uint8 conversion excluded; included in E2E.
protocol.e2e: E2E-given-inputs: input decode/read, geometry/control adaptation, full method pipeline, CPU output transfer and clamp/round RGB8. Excludes model loading, output file writing, video encoding, metrics, unavailable GT generation and external depth estimation.
protocol.drbokeh: Synthetic GT union alpha + LaMa reconstruction, frozen gamma2.2/lens71/grid2d; not DAVIS Full-public
protocol.deeplens: Frozen external-geometry TF1.15 CPU / single SR / aperture saturation, not DAVIS native DepthNet
protocol.time: perf_counter with GPU synchronize at clip/core boundaries; nested Core within E2E in the same repeat; no production jobs in parallel
protocol.rng: Separate timing process, initial seed0 (BokehDiff42), continuous stream across warmup/repeats; does not change saved quality outputs or their RNG states
protocol.peak_memory: Per-unit PyTorch allocated/reserved peaks after warmup; Table3B device total sampled0.2s (includes CUDA/CuPy); native CPU RSS sampled0.2s during repeats. Units GiB (2^30 bytes). Loading peak excluded.
protocol.aggregation: Per-scene mean/std over5 repeats, then equal mean over4 scenes; FPS=25/mean E2E seconds; preserve all raw repeats and by-K values

core_regions.any2bokeh: Public video pipeline on already-CUDA RGB/CoC/MPI/K/weights through CUDA float output; three native calls emitting8/8/9frames, overlap assembly included. Host transfers outside.
core_regions.mpib: Official inpnet, mpinet, aupnet and MPI renderer forward calls on CUDA inputs; CPU mask construction/intermediate resize and transfers are E2E-only.
core_regions.bokehme: Official demo pipeline on already-CUDA RGB/defocus through CUDA output, including classical/neural branches and blend; transfers outside.
core_regions.drbokeh: LaMa model.forward twice and Multi_Layer_Renderer.forward on already-CUDA RGBAD. GT-alpha layer construction, cv2 repair, input/output transfer and photometric CPU postprocess are E2E-only.
core_regions.bokehdiff: Public VAE.encode plus TiledSDXL pipeline on CUDA RGB/condition through CUDA float output; no diagnostic CPU copy or PIL conversion in Core. Frozen PISA/seed retained.
core_regions.deeplens: Native TF1 session.run of LensBlur+singleSR graph; external geometry mapping, numpy validation and final RGB uint8 conversion outside Core. CPU only.

protocol.unit: Frame methods record each real single-frame unit; ATB records its real8/8/9-output calls. Table3A time is measured Core sum divided by actual emitted frames; no synthetic single-frame video entry.
protocol.core_timing_overhead: Nested synchronized Core measurement adds synchronization overhead to E2E; no asynchronous unsynchronized timings.
protocol.GFLOPs: After latency repeats, separate diagnostic dispatcher count perK. Preserve operator coverage and countable arithmetic; report N/A when full floating-point path is not covered, never label a partial count full-pipeline GFLOPs.
protocol.selection: First frame of each of the fixed4 clips for frame methods; full25-frame native path for Any-to-Bokeh. Selected before timing; no independent one-frame ATB entry.

scope: Only frozen Table3 core latency and peak memory remeasurement; no optimizations, stage profiling, failure analysis or full quality metrics.
hardware_comparison: Old RTX PRO6000 Blackwell results remain separately stored; no cross-device speedup ratio computed.

table.GFLOPs_status: N/A: full operator coverage not established; no partial count reported

protocol.name: MagicBokeh frozen medoid B Table3 generator cost
protocol.native_input: RGB and one target-guided click; visible GT target alpha and native predicted depth assist point selection outside model. No GT numeric depth, mask, alpha or hidden RGB fed to generator
protocol.generator: Author FP16 model_test, 512x512 tiles, stride256, original overlap reconstruction, PIL conversion and AdaIN
protocol.control: abs(PNG8 predicted depth /255 - native focus) * (K/32); focus mask threshold0.1
protocol.efficiency_inputs: Same four first-frame RGBs and K values as configs/efficiency-track-a.json; depth/focus predicted natively, not benchmark geometry
protocol.core: Six native generator tile forwards plus author CUDA overlap reconstruction per1024x576 output frame; GPU input/control construction, DAdepth, LDF, transfer, CPU PIL/AdaIN and disk I/O excluded
protocol.parameters: Unique learned parameters in actually invoked generator modules, including text encoder; DAdepth and LDF preprocessing parameters excluded with their time
protocol.scope: Table3 generator cost only, not whole RGB-to-bokeh latency; no claim of temporal modeling or physically equivalent K
protocol.focus: Native PNG8 predicted depth at target-guided medoid click
protocol.RNG: Separate timing process seed0 and continuous stream over warmups/repeats; does not change quality outputs
